reasoning_content:
We need to start the stack. That requires building the server image which may involve downloading Elixir, building etc. Let's start `docker compose up` in detached mode to avoid blocking. Actually docker compose up will build the server image. Let me do that with -d and capture logs. This may take a long time (Elixir build). Timeout 600s per command. Let me build first in background perhaps. Let me try `docker compose up -d --build` but that could exceed 600s. Better run in background with nohup and poll.

Let me first check network availability and pull base images. Let's start building.

I'll run docker compose up -d in background writing to a log.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose_up.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"; sleep 30; tail -20 /tmp/compose_up.log
